verdict.rationale: Postman's own CLI docs say it checks API specifications against configured API governance rules. The release notes add that the CLI can lint API schemas and run security and governance checks, which covers the core story directly. missing for 10: documentation of how style and governance rulesets are authored or customized (custom rules, severity levels, rule formats), explicit coverage of style rules as distinct from governance rules, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can lint API specs against configurable style and governance rules

citations.quote: Check API specifications against configured API governance rules.
The Postman CLI enables you to run collections, lint API schemas, run security and governance checks, and log in and out.
